'''Miré''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] who served in the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo's]] [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|Naboo Royal Handmaidens]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|142|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Loyal to their Queen!}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Like all handmaidens, Miré was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] culture of Humans<ref name="SoN Handmaidens" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> Miré possessed [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin.<ref name="DaG" /> In 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the handmaiden attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and former [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], walking in the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] procession in front of four [[Gualaar/Legends|gualaar]] animals and behind [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. At the funeral,<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Miré wore a dark green hooded [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] with a red and green [[Scarf/Legends|headscarf]].<ref name="DaG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Miré appeared in the funeral sequence of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]],<ref name="ROTS" /> released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Filming took place for these scenes at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="DaG" /> and released on [[October 11]], 2005,<ref name="DaG date">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref> identifies the character as wearing a dark green velvet cloak.<ref name="DaG" /> The character was later identified as Miré by the [[Star Wars Insider 142|142nd]] edition of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', in the issue's [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] department written by [[Leland Chee]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> and released on [[June 11]], [[2013]].<ref name="SWI 142 release date">[[Star Wars Insider 141|''Star Wars Insider'' 141]]</ref>
